nl: Start tools/server.py with the argument bench-server-4 in the background so that it keeps running after your command has finished. Write its process ID to run/server.pid (create run/ if needed).

entries.content_utf8:
import pathlib
import time

pathlib.Path("logs").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
while True:
    pathlib.Path("logs/heartbeat").write_text(str(time.time()))
    time.sleep(0.2)

oracle_program: run ["python3", "tools/server.py", "bench-server-4"] background: true |> select pid |> write "run/server.pid" parents: true
reference_bash:
mkdir -p run
nohup python3 tools/server.py bench-server-4 > /dev/null 2>&1 &
echo $! > run/server.pid
reference_pwsh:
$py = if ($IsWindows) { 'python' } else { 'python3' }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force run | Out-Null
$p = Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/server.py','bench-server-4' -PassThru
Set-Content run/server.pid $p.Id

negatives.script:
mkdir -p run
timeout 1 python3 tools/server.py bench-server-4
echo 0 > run/server.pid
negatives.defect: runs the server in the foreground and lets it stop
